expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full component with Document type, selection state management (ExplicitSelection / AllMatchingSelection), mutation logic, pagination, and table rendering

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Contains implemented functions: toggleDocument(), selectAllMatching(), executeBulkAction(), PageSelectionCheckbox component, all state hooks wired together

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete action only has two-step confirmation UI (click 'Delete', then 'Confirm delete'); no trash/soft-delete or actual recovery mechanism shown

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: "{count.toLocaleString()} document{count === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected" displayed in bulk action bar before buttons

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Separate UI block: "All {documents.length} documents on this page are selected... Select all {totalMatching.toLocaleString()} matching documents" with explicit conditional rendering for different selection modes

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button uses 'bg-white...text-slate-800' (neutral), Delete button uses 'bg-red-600...text-white' (red) or appears in conditional confirmDelete block

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button appears first in DOM order and has neutral white styling; Delete is secondary, only becomes prominent during confirmation flow

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Explicit comment: "For all-matching selections, the server should resolve the query within the current user's authorized tenant and ideally queue a background job"

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Code ends with closing brace of component; no prose or documentation describing what attacks/misuses the design prevents
